description: Drinking Water Inspectorate (DWI) sequel database system is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. Drinking Water Inspectorate (DWI) information related to water company drinking water quality technical data and associated information. Data collected from local authorities describing private water supplies. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs. The portal shows 2013-12-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
